description: Moves an Umbraco package to a new CMS major (for example 17 to 18): finds the breaking changes that hit it, writes an ordered checklist in `docs/upgrades/v<major>.md`, and works through it with the builder and reviewer agents. Use for "upgrade to Umbraco N", "support v18", a new major's beta or RC, or moving from one RC to the next. Not for minor or patch bumps.
